description: Runs on file save in Kiro: syntax-check app.js and remind the author to keep .kiro/ visible to Git. This is the hook config used while building Ghost Pomodoro; Kiro runs it on save, and the same checks can be run by hand (see hooks/README.md).

actions.description: Fail the save hook if app.js has a syntax error.

actions.command: grep -q '^\.kiro' .gitignore && echo 'WARNING: .kiro is gitignored — Devpost requires it at the repo root' || echo 'OK: .kiro is not gitignored'
actions.description: Guard the Devpost requirement that /.kiro stays committed.

actions.command: grep -qi 'todo' index.html && echo 'WARNING: literal TODO found in index.html — remove placeholder text before submitting' || echo 'OK: no TODO in index.html'
actions.description: Keep placeholder text out of the user-facing UI.

name: on-save-check
